title: eBalistyka EbcpData
description: Canonical schema for the app's protobuf EbcpData document (snake_case, as produced by EbcpValidator's hand-written proto→JSON conversion) — the shareable/exportable .ebcp container, successor to today's ZIP+JSON .ebcp format. Bundles one or more ProfilesData blocks and, optionally, one SettingsData block. See docs/backlogs/8.PROTOBUF_STORAGE_MIGRATION.md. ProfilesData/SettingsData are not redefined here — bin/embed_schema.dart inlines the real $defs from profiles.schema.json/settings.schema.json at embed time (see that script's _mergeExternalDefs), so this source file stays the single point of truth for EbcpData only.

settings_data.description: Absent when this .ebcp carries no settings (e.g. a single-profile share).
